info.title: MRCP-Engine API
info.description: Headless middleware for structural intelligence. Converts raw repositories into semantic JSON graphs, eliminating AI Tax and reducing token usage by 99%.

get.description: Fetches the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) and architectural graph of a given repository, returning a highly optimized semantic JSON payload.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: The URL of the repository to analyze (e.g., https://github.com/user/project)

200.description: Successful extraction of the architectural graph.
